prompt:
Character reference model sheet for a 2D video game. PURE BLACK background. Three full-body views of the SAME character, side by side, identical size and standing on one shared ground line: front view left, exact side profile center, back view right. Flat cel-shaded vector illustration, bold clean linework, hard-edged shadows, no gradients, no soft rendering, no photorealism.

CHARACTER — a cyberpunk death god. Lean, athletic, agile build, relaxed neutral standing pose, arms at sides.

HE IS A BLACK MAN WITH DEEP BROWN SKIN. Skin ramp: shadow #4A2A1A, base #855434, highlight #B07A4A, with a thin cyan rim light along the edges. Skin is visible at the neck, at both bare forearms, and at both hands — the jacket sleeves are pushed up to the elbows.

FACE — a Japanese hannya oni demon mask covering the ENTIRE face, forehead to chin, in bright electric red #E01F26 with darker red #8F1116 carved detail lines. NO skin and NO facial features are visible anywhere on the head — the mask IS the whole face. The narrow angular eye slits and the wide fanged grinning mouth are open holes glowing with pale cyan-white spirit light from inside an empty skull, and that same ghost light bleeds out from behind the rim of the mask along the jawline. A small glowing cyan third eye sits on the mask's forehead. Two long twisted ridged horns in bright red sweep BACKWARD from the temples — angled back behind the head, never upward.

HAIR — very long straight hair in a high ponytail trailing far down past the hips, in three flat color bands: deep indigo #1E33D9 at the roots, electric blue #2B6FE8 through the middle, bright cyan #35C6F4 at the tips, with pale cyan #8FE8FF wisps at the very end. Tied with an acid-green #C6F02A band. The ponytail is a major part of the silhouette — long and flowing, but hanging BEHIND the body, never covering the torso.

OUTFIT — modern streetwear fused with samurai dress:
- a black athletic TRACKSUIT jacket, stand-up zip collar, twin parallel racing stripes in acid green #C6F02A and cyan #35C6F4 down the outside of both sleeves, sleeves pushed up to the elbows with ribbed cuffs
- black HAKAMA trousers, wide and pleated through the thigh, the same twin racing stripes down the outer seam, gathered into elastic tracksuit cuffs at the ankles
- black tabi split-toe boots
- a deep blue #1E33D9 obi sash at the waist with a thin acid-green line
- over everything, a PURE WHITE SLEEVELESS captain's haori: long, past the knee, hanging open at the front, BROAD and heavy so it dominates the silhouette, with a torn ragged frayed hem. It is the brightest thing in the image and reads against the black background. On the BACK view, the haori's back panel is marked with '0x0029' in small dark monospace characters above two large red kanji 死神.

WEAPONS — a matched samurai daisho pair, one long katana and one shorter wakizashi, both in black lacquered scabbards thrust through the sash at the LEFT hip ONLY, angled down and back, katana above wakizashi. No weapons on the back or the right side. Identical placement in all three views. A thin acid-green glowing line runs along each scabbard mouth and sword guard.

STRICT PALETTE — use ONLY: #000000 #0A0E1F #1E33D9 #2B6FE8 #35C6F4 #8FE8FF #8F1116 #E01F26 #C6F02A #6B8A0F #FFFFFF #4A5568 #4A2A1A #855434 #B07A4A. No purple, no orange, no teal, no pink. High-contrast neon on pure black.

Game character model sheet, evenly lit, no background scenery, no text labels, no logos, no watermark.

Cinematic video game key art, flat bold cel-shaded anime illustration with heavy black shadows and dramatic neon rim lighting.

A lone cyberpunk death god stands on a rain-slicked neon rooftop above a dense futuristic Japanese megacity at night. Glowing holographic signage in cyan and acid green, towering skyscrapers fading into fog, and a colossal distant torii gate silhouetted on the skyline. Rain streaks the air, neon reflections pool on the wet rooftop.

HE IS A BLACK MAN WITH DEEP BROWN SKIN (#855434 base, #4A2A1A shadow, #B07A4A highlight) — visible on his bare forearms and hands, sleeves pushed to the elbows, with cyan rim light along his arms. His face is covered ENTIRELY by a bright red #E01F26 hannya oni demon mask with narrow glowing white eye slits, a fanged grin leaking pale cyan spirit light, a cyan third eye on the forehead, and two long twisted red horns sweeping BACKWARD. Extremely long ponytail streaming dramatically in the wind, banded deep indigo to electric blue to bright cyan.

He wears a black tracksuit jacket with acid-green and cyan racing stripes down the sleeves, black pleated hakama trousers gathered at the ankles, black tabi boots, and a BROAD PURE WHITE SLEEVELESS captain's haori with a torn ragged hem billowing hugely in the wind — the white haori is the brightest mass in the image and frames his whole silhouette.

ACTION — caught mid iaido draw-cut, ripping the katana from its black scabbard at his left hip. The exposed blade burns with a searing acid-green #C6F02A temper line and leaves a huge bright arcing slash trail cutting through the rain. The shorter wakizashi stays sheathed at his sash. Small floating green spirit flames drift around him.

STRICT PALETTE — use ONLY: #000000 #0A0E1F #1E33D9 #2B6FE8 #35C6F4 #8FE8FF #8F1116 #E01F26 #C6F02A #6B8A0F #FFFFFF #4A5568 #4A2A1A #855434 #B07A4A. No purple, no orange, no pink. No text, no logos, no watermark.
